name: YOURCHANNEL
style: No-commentary, cinematic 4K gameplay. Short punchy hooks, game abbreviation after a pipe.

rules: Never a bare game name as the whole title.
Hook first, game after the pipe.
At most 2 emoji; flag emoji only when the location is actually in the footage.
#Shorts only on Shorts, never on long-form (strip_shorts_tag.py exists because of this).
Mission names and numbers must match what is on screen.

hashtags.why: YouTube shows only 3 hashtags above the title; use 3-5 precise, video-related hashtags. Brand name goes in tags, not hashtags.

description.footer:
🎮 Your Channel | Your tagline.
Recorded in 4K. No commentary.
https://www.youtube.com/@yourchannel

upload.synthetic_voice_rule: Any upload whose job has cloned-voice narration (ytm.py voice say --job) is uploaded with containsSyntheticMedia=true - YouTube's 'altered or synthetic content' disclosure. A realistic AI voice of a real person narrating requires it. Never turn this off.

shorts.post_times_why: Set these from YouTube Studio > Analytics > Audience > 'When your viewers are on YouTube'.

corners.why: 4K HDR top-right in white, PS5 logo top-left. HDR only when the recording is HDR (accuracy). Drop a white PS5 PNG at config/ps5_logo.png to use it instead of the PS5 text.

thumbnail.quality_rule: Thumbnails are made at full 4K; the uploaded JPEG is the same image compressed to fit max_bytes.

rules: Long-form title: the searched keyword in the first ~40 characters (game + what people search), then mission name, then '4K'.
Shorts title: hook first, then the searched keyword, then #Shorts.
First description line = the search phrase in plain words, accurate to the footage.
Tags: 10-15 real search phrases from data/analytics/search-terms-latest.json, no padding.
Long-form: chapters + link to the series playlist in the description.
Never put a keyword that is not in the footage (accuracy rule wins over SEO).
seo.evidence: Fill in from your own YouTube search-terms report.

grade.encoder_why: Benchmark, 20 s 4K60 SDR @45M: hevc_amf 1.16x realtime SSIM 0.99806; libx265 medium 0.21x SSIM 0.99791. Pick the hardware encoder your GPU supports.
grade.why: Optional SDR-only look (eq + unsharp). Applied only after the user approves the BEFORE/AFTER preview for a job. Output stays SDR bt709 - never labelled HDR.

engagement.rule: Never beg for likes, subscribes or the bell - in titles, descriptions, pinned comments, on-screen text, stream overlays or voiceover. Earn the subscribe with value; invite opinions instead.
do: ask a real question about the moment (stealth or loud? would you have saved him?)
pin a comment that starts a conversation, not a CTA
reply to comments like a person
live: let chat decide routes/loadouts, greet first-time chatters by name, react for real
point to the next mission/playlist as a service, not a demand
Community posts: polls on which game/mission next
dont: 'subscribe for more' in footers or overlays
engagement.why: Engage with the audience instead of asking for subscriptions and likes.

voice.reference: data/voice/ref.wav (a clean 10-25 s sample of your own voice)
voice.style: Short, punchy narration with reactions. Tag every line [calm] [hook] [react] or [hype].

longform.publish_why: Pick days/time from your own Studio audience heatmap, 1-2 h before the peak.
